title: Ecovyst Announces Chief Executive Officer Transition and Reaffirms Full-Year 2026 Guidance
body_markdown:
WAYNE, Pa.


, Nov. 18, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Ecovyst Inc. (NYSE: ECVT) ("Ecovyst" or the "Company"), a leading provider of regenerated sulfuric acid, virgin sulfuric acid, and sulfur dioxide and related derivatives, today announced that the Board of Directors of the Company has appointed current director David A. Bradley as Interim Chief Executive Officer effective November 17, 2026. Mr. Bradley replaces Kurt J. Bitting, who will be departing the Company.


"David is a respected and skillful chemical industry veteran, and we believe his experience in this sector will serve the Company and its stockholders well as Ecovyst pursues its strategic growth plans," said Kevin M. Fogarty, Ecovyst's Chairman of the Board of Directors. "The Board believes that David will further accelerate the execution of our strategic objectives, with an eye toward generating additional stockholder value while we undertake a comprehensive search process to identify a permanent Chief Executive Officer for the Company. On behalf of our Board of Directors and the management team, I also want to thank Kurt for his hard work and dedication on behalf of the Company and for his many contributions to Ecovyst. We wish Kurt all the best in the future," Mr. Fogarty said.


Mr. Bradley, 55, has been a director of the Company since 2022. Mr. Bradley previously served as the President and Chief Executive Officer and member of the board of directors of SI Group from March 2019 to October 2026. Prior to joining SI Group, Mr. Bradley served as President and Chief Executive Officer and member of the board of directors of Nexeo Solutions from March 2011 until February 2019. Prior to that, Mr. Bradley spent seven years at Kraton Corporation, where he held several executive positions, including Chief Operating Officer, Vice President of Global Operations, and Vice President of Business Transformation. Since 2019, he also has been a member of the board of directors of South Texas Truck Centers LLP.


It is expected that Mr. Bitting will continue as a consultant to the Company until February 5, 2027 in order to provide for a smooth transition of his prior duties to Mr. Bradley.


**Fourth Quarter and Full-Year 2026 Outlook**


Ecovyst today reaffirmed the financial guidance for the fourth quarter and full-year 2026 that it provided on November 5, 2026 in its third quarter earnings results and press release.

**About Ecovyst Inc.**


Ecovyst Inc. and subsidiaries is a leading provider of regenerated sulfuric acid, virgin sulfuric acid, and sulfur dioxide and related derivatives essential to our customers' operations and processes.


Our platform of virgin sulfuric acid products, regenerated sulfuric acid and related derivatives serve a wide range of industrial applications. We are a leading provider of regenerated sulfuric acid to the North American refining industry for the production of alkylate, an essential gasoline component for lowering vapor pressure and increasing octane to meet stringent gasoline specifications and fuel efficiency standards. We are a leading North American producer of high quality and high strength virgin sulfuric acid for industrial and mining applications. Through our Calabrian business, we are also a leading producer of sulfur dioxide and related derivatives in North America, serving key end uses including mining, water treatment and specialty chemical production. We also provide chemical waste handling and treatment services, as well as ex-situ catalyst activation services for the refining and petrochemical industry.


For more information, see our website at[https://www.ecovyst.com](https://www.ecovyst.com/) .
